items.title: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest earthquake in years
items.description: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

items.title: Canada flight cancelled after child refuses to wear seat belt
items.description: The incident has sparked a debate over child safety and discipline on commercial planes.

items.title: Watch: What we know about Tupac murder suspect Duane 'Keffe D' Davis
items.description: The trial of the 63-year-old former gang boss kicked off on Monday, and he has entered a not guilty plea.

items.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
items.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack - one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

items.title: Netanyahu's rejection of Trump's 15-point Gaza plan unlikely to be final word
items.description: The Trump administration is said to be unbothered by the Israeli prime minister's rejection of the deal, viewing it as campaign rhetoric ahead of a general election.

items.title: 'We've had a lot of close calls': Canada wildfire evacuees wonder if they still have homes
items.description: More than 12,000 people have been forced to evacuate and some homes have been lost after a wildfire tore through Canada's picturesque Okanagan region.

items.title: 30 years later, a former gang member will stand trial for Tupac's murder
items.description: It’s been three decades since Tupac was killed, and since then, his reputation has only grown.

items.title: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
items.description: The American Academy of Pediatrics calls the recommendation on measles, mumps and rubella shots "dangerous".

items.title: Jackie, the famous California bald eagle, dies after weeks of intensive care
items.description: Jackie and her partner, Shadow, had been watched by millions of people over the years through the Big Bear Eagle Nest Cam.

items.title: New train service connects Finland and Sweden for first time in decades
items.description: The service will enable rail travel from Portugal to Lapland - what is believed to be the longest train journey in Europe.

items.title: Wall Street giants hand Nvidia $500bn to fund boom in AI projects

items.title: The lonely Chinese men being conned by fake brides

items.title: Watch: Moment powerful earthquake shakes Colombia and crumbles buildings
